steps.why: We take five at a time, so these get read properly and you get a reply either way.
steps.required: A brand name, even a working one.

steps.why: The store, or an Instagram handle if the store is not up yet.

fields.aria: Your store link or Instagram handle

steps.why: In your own words. Streetwear, jewellery, ceramics, prints, music, whatever it is.

steps.q: How do you sell? Big drops, or always on?
steps.why: Do you release collections on a schedule, or keep the same things for sale all the time?

steps.q: Roughly how much does it sell a month?
steps.why: This is the number that decides whether we can help, so an honest answer is worth more than a flattering one. Small is not a problem. Guessing is.
steps.required: Pick the closest one — it is the question that matters most.

steps.q: Roughly, how much of the price is what it costs you to make?
steps.why: A rough guess is fine. Materials, blanks, printing, whatever goes into one piece.
steps.aria: Cost as a share of price

steps.q: And what are you spending on ads?
steps.why: Whatever it is. We price on the work, not the budget, so a small number here does not count against you.

steps.q: What are you trying to do in the next six months?
steps.why: A launch, a drop, getting off a plateau, running ads properly for the first time.

fields.placeholder: Where you are trying to get to
fields.aria: What you are trying to do in the next six months

steps.q: Who are we speaking to, and where do we send the answer?
steps.why: We read these ourselves, both of us. You will hear back whether it is a fit or not.
steps.required: We need somewhere to send the answer.
steps.emailError: That email does not look right.

done.body: We read these in order and reply either way, the same working day. If it is urgent, email diego@kaizenevol.com and say so.
